audit.whatIsWrong: Not one of Galio's abilities is named anywhere on the page — it is all 'his Q', 'his W taunt', 'his E knock-up dash'.
audit.why: Riot's names are Colossal Smash (P), Winds of War (Q), Shield of Durand (W), Justice Punch (E) and Hero's Entrance (R); the reader cannot track a cooldown they cannot name.
audit.corrected: Real names written into the spikes, the foe wants, and the Level 1 phase.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike calls his ultimate 'R global' with no name and no cooldown.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 with a 4000-5500 range — the roam threat is real but it is also the longest cooldown in the lane.
audit.corrected: Spike now names Hero's Entrance and gives the cooldown so the roam window is trackable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Unstoppable Force's knock-up interrupts Shield of Durand's charge, and the itemization line tells you to build against 'his AD profile'.
audit.why: Shield of Durand is a charged stance that taunts on release, so displacement during the charge denies the taunt. Galio's damage is magic across Colossal Smash, Winds of War and Shield of Durand, so armour is the wrong buy.
audit.corrected: Interaction added to Key Ability Interactions; itemization corrected to magic resist.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block names Justice Punch but gives no numbers for anything.
audit.why: Winds of War 11s to 7s, Shield of Durand 18s to 14s, Justice Punch 11s to 7s, Hero's Entrance 180/160/140.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the cooldown breakdown and the first Do.

edits.before: Galio owns the opening — his Q double-ring poke and passive magic-damage auto chunk you while your Granite Shield just eats it and refreshes.
edits.after: Galio owns the opening — Winds of War (Q) lands two rings and Colossal Smash turns his next auto into magic damage while Granite Shield just eats it.

edits.before: His biggest threat window: W taunt + R global means a roaming Galio can be the one making plays, not you — your R is still your only flip button.
edits.after: His threat window: Shield of Durand (W) taunts you out of your combo and Hero's Entrance (R, 180s at rank 1) lets him decide another lane instead of yours.

edits.before: Poke you down with his double-ring Q and passive magic autos before your Granite Shield refreshes
edits.after: Poke you down with Winds of War (Q) and Colossal Smash autos before Granite Shield refreshes

edits.before: Hit his W taunt to lock you out of your combo and tank your trade for free
edits.after: Charge Shield of Durand (W) to taunt you out of your combo and tank the trade

edits.before: Use his global R to roam and snowball other lanes since he can't be solo-killed by a low-damage tank
edits.after: Use Hero's Entrance (R) to roam and snowball another lane, since a low-damage tank cannot solo-kill him

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Identify how Galio contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Winds of War out-ranges everything you own and Colossal Smash adds a free magic auto. Last-hit at range and let Granite Shield refresh.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (E): 11s at rank 1, 7s at rank 5 — his dash and knock-up, so step up once it misses. - Shield of Durand (W): 18s — the taunt that eats your combo. - Hero's Entrance (R): 180/160/140. - Your ultimate: 130s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — Q-poke, R the pick.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E, 11s at rank 1) is his engage. Your knock-up interrupts Shield of Durand mid-charge, denying the taunt.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet / Frozen Heart  (by his AD profile), then Thornmail / Abyssal Mask; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet / Frozen Heart, then Abyssal Mask — his damage is all magic, so MR over armour; boots Mercury's Treads.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His dash and knock-up engage, 11s at rank 1. Step up the moment it is spent or missed.

notes: Malphite's kit file derives a 'grounding' flag on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam that Riot's descriptions do not support (move-speed steal and attack-speed reduction only) — no grounding claim written. The knock-up-interrupts-Shield-of-Durand line is marked Medium: Riot's text confirms W is a charged stance released into a taunt, but the kit files carry no explicit displacement-interrupt data.
